name: image-story
style: one look for the whole video, a picture drawn for each stretch of speech

calls.why: Read the script like a director: its kind, the hook, what each sentence shows, the look.
Group the sentences into pictures; nothing holds over three seconds.
Check the opening: a weak first line gets better ones to choose from; nothing is changed by itself.
Write the plan the person will look at: no picture is drawn yet.

inputs.question: Here is the plan. Change anything, then press Start.

calls.why: Nothing expensive starts until the person has seen the plan, if the setting says so.
Wait for the person; an unanswered plan stops, it never spends.
Draw the pictures and put the video together, exactly as approved.

inputs.summary: The video was made from the approved plan.
